Native source-aligned manuscript descriptions of functional trajectory analyses

etr_native_manuscript_reporting.Rd

Eight Python-free descriptive text reporting functions for audited native R distance, FPCA, resampling and multilevel outputs.

Usage

etr_dynamic_time_warping_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_trajectory_distance_sensitivity_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_stability_reporting_text(result,
  similarity_threshold = 0.80, digits = 2L)
etr_fpca_outlier_reporting_text(result)
etr_fpca_influence_reporting_text(result, digits = 2L)
etr_fpca_subspace_stability_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_cross_validation_reporting_text(result,
  rule = "minimum", digits = 3L)
etr_multilevel_fpca_reporting_text(result, digits = 1L)

Arguments

result

A compatible, independently computed native R result of the type corresponding to the reporting function.

digits

Finite, nonnegative integer display precision.

similarity_threshold

Absolute matched-FPC similarity cutoff in the closed interval [0,1].

rule

Held-out cross-validation component selection: "minimum" or "one_se".

Value

A single descriptive character string for manuscript drafting.

Details

Texts are source-aligned with published eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0, but derive values from native R scientific estimators and containers, which are not always behaviorally identical to the source estimators. A successful text-oracle comparison is not independent numerical validation of the underlying estimator, nor a signed full public source contract. R and Python formatting/validation boundary cases require independent review. Bootstrap stability, influence, anomaly flags and multiverse distances are descriptive: they are not automatically calibrated probabilities or reasons for exclusion.
